hooks.excerpt: The Rangers in the South is a PIXELART ACTION ROGUELIKE RPG set in a beautiful 2.5D world inspired by the SNES classics.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无预设职业，用数百能力特质与随机装备造角色
hooks.excerpt: No predefined classes, with hundreds of unique abilities, character traits, and procedurally generated equipment, you'll have to carve your path through hordes of enemies to make each character unique!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色永久死亡，但探索、物品与金币跨角色保留
hooks.excerpt: Be careful, death is irreversible! . REPLAYABILITY IS THE WAY Death will be your best teacher! Start new characters to discover new possibilities, items, and abilities. But not all is lost! Progress between each character is stored in the form of exploration, items, and gold!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
